title: Implement fixed-score annotated assessment POC
description: Render the fixed C major exercise as notated score, keep the four-click assessment flow, and annotate each note with timing/intonation issues after playback.
acceptance_criteria: Rendered fixed score, four-click count-in, note-by-note timing/intonation analysis, per-note issue annotations on score, playback highlighting on score, README updated for fixed-score-only scope.
notes:
Spec source: openspec/specs/fixed-score-annotated-assessment.md
Implemented fixed-score SVG staff rendering, per-note issue annotations, playback highlighting on score, and fixed-scope README/docs updates.
Refined the fixed score to a treble-clef 4/4 melody with simple rhythmic variation and accidentals (F# and G#), and updated rendering/timing assumptions accordingly.
